These changes feel right overall.

- The icon and preview make the cards easier to recognize. I like the thumbnail on the left. When no preview exists, I’d rather omit that thumbnail area and let the text use the space—the “no preview” box adds visual noise without helping me.
- “Read later” being on by default matches how I’d usually save things. I should still be able to turn it off here, as shown, and change that status later.
- The reusable label suggestions are exactly what I wanted.
- Quietly opening the existing bookmark for editing is the right behavior. The heading makes it clear why I’m there, so a separate warning would just add friction.

One correction to that existing-bookmark editor: I’d expect to be able to change the saved address there too, along with the title, description, labels, note, and read-later status.
